This scatterplot below shows the relationship between a car’s weight (wt) and its fuel efficiency (mpg).

Heavier cars tend to get fewer miles per gallon.

Lighter cars are generally more efficient.

Let’s look at number of cylinders. The table below shows average horsepower, weight, and fuel efficiency for 4, 6, and 8-cylinder cars.

4-cylinder cars are the clear winners in fuel efficiency.

8-cylinder cars dominate in raw horsepower.
